summary_1line: A discourse on the power of Time, the cycle of joy and sorrow, detachment from grief, and the righteous duties that lead a king to heaven.

image_candidates.scene_text: A grieving king sits beside a sage while the cycles of nature—rising sun, full moon, storms, blooming lotuses, and flowing rivers—unfold around them as symbols of Time.
A battlefield king stands with bow in hand while priests pour Soma in sacrifice, merging the imagery of war, ritual fire, and divine ascent.
A serene sage walks along a radiant northern path under a bright sky while another path leads southward through ritual fires and warriors.
